home.metaDescription: MoneySpender helps you track income, expenses, debts, and personal money goals.
home.title: Track money in, money out, and debts without the drama.
home.description: MoneySpender is built for the small habit people keep forgetting: writing transactions down. Open it, fill it in for a moment, and see your money picture clearly.
home.featuresSubtitle: The focus is simple: tidy records, a readable dashboard, and reminders so the habit lasts beyond the first week of the month.
home.highlight1Detail: Log income, expenses, or debts the moment they happen. The recap takes care of itself.
home.highlight2Title: Sign in the way you like
home.highlight2Detail: Use email, a magic link, or Google. Pick whatever is simplest for you.
home.highlight3Detail: Records are stored securely, never sold, and you can export or delete them anytime from settings.
home.signInDetail: Create an account or sign in with Google. Once you're in, you can add transactions and check your summary right away.
home.signInExtra: You can also set financial goals and track your net worth.

privacy.metaDescription: MoneySpender privacy policy for web users, email login, and Google Sign-In.
privacy.title: Your data is used only where needed.
privacy.description: MoneySpender needs some data so that login, records, the dashboard, and reminders can work. This page explains the short, clear version.
privacy.summaryP1: MoneySpender is a personal finance tracking app. Data is used to store your records, render the dashboard, keep you signed in, and send the reminders you enable.
privacy.s1i1: Your name, email, and the basic info you provide when registering or signing in with Google.
privacy.s1i2: The records you save in MoneySpender, such as income, expenses, debts, categories, goals, and reminders.
privacy.s1i3: Minimal technical data, such as login sessions, push notification endpoints, and basic security logs.
privacy.s2i1: Running the core features: login, dashboard, transaction records, reminders, sync, and account reset.
privacy.s2i2: Keeping your account secure and diagnosing technical problems when something breaks.
privacy.s2i3: Sending reminders only when you have turned them on.
privacy.s3i1: Data is stored with the services the app needs to run, such as hosting, authentication, database, and notifications.
privacy.s3i2: Your personal data is never sold.
privacy.s3i3: Data is only shared when required to operate the service, meet legal obligations, or protect security.
privacy.s4i1: You can update your account data and records directly in the app wherever the feature exists.
privacy.s4i2: You can request account deletion or access deactivation via the contact on this page, or through the delete-account option in settings.
privacy.s4i3: You can stop using Google Sign-In anytime from your Google account settings.
privacy.s5i1: Vercel — application hosting and cookie-free aggregate analytics.
privacy.s5i2: Supabase — authentication, database, and application data storage.
privacy.s5i3: Google — only if you choose to sign in with Google (OAuth).
privacy.s5i4: Your browser/OS push service (e.g. Google, Apple, Mozilla) — only if you enable reminders.
privacy.s6i1: Data is kept while your account is active so your records and dashboard stay available.
privacy.s6i2: When you delete your account, your personal data and records are removed from the application database.
privacy.s6i3: Technical backups and security logs may persist briefly after deletion before being purged automatically.
privacy.s7i1: You may request access to, a copy of, correction of, or deletion of your personal data.
privacy.s7i2: You may object to or restrict certain processing, and lodge a complaint with the data protection authority in your region.
privacy.s7i3: Your data is not sold, so there is no 'data sale' to opt out of. Send any rights request via the contact below.
privacy.contactText: Questions about privacy, data deletion, or Google Sign-In? Contact:

terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions for using MoneySpender.
terms.title: Short rules that keep MoneySpender safe to use.
terms.description: By using MoneySpender you agree to use the app fairly, look after your own account, and understand the limits of the service.
terms.summaryP1: This is the short version of how to use MoneySpender, your responsibilities, and the limits of the service.
terms.s1i1: MoneySpender exists to help you record and understand your personal finances.
terms.s1i2: You are responsible for the data you enter into the app.
terms.s1i3: Use the app fairly and do not attempt to compromise security or other users' access.
terms.s2i1: Protect the email, password, and Google access connected to your account.
terms.s2i2: If you suspect someone else is using your account, change your credentials and contact us immediately.
terms.s2i3: Access may be restricted in case of unlawful activity or behavior that endangers the service.
terms.s3i1: Features may change as the product is improved, secured, and developed.
terms.s3i2: We work to keep the service available, but technical disruptions can still happen.
terms.s3i3: Use the service at your own discretion, to the extent permitted by applicable law.
terms.s4i1: The transaction data you enter remains yours. MoneySpender only processes it to make features work.
terms.s4i2: Do not use the service for content that is illegal, harmful, misleading, or infringes others' rights.
terms.s4i3: Where required by law, access may be suspended or specific information provided to competent authorities.
terms.s5i1: MoneySpender's core features are free. If paid plans become available, their price and contents are shown clearly before you pay.
terms.s5i2: Paid subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period.
terms.s5i3: Payments are processed by a third-party payment provider. MoneySpender does not store your card number.
terms.s6i1: You can cancel your subscription anytime from account settings. Paid access stays active until the end of the current period.
terms.s6i2: Refunds follow the consumer protection laws applicable in your region.
terms.s6i3: If you believe a charge is incorrect, contact us within 30 days so we can investigate.
